items.author: chatgpt-codex-connector[bot]
items.body:
**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Trust each untrusted tap, not only installed packages**

`--formula`/`--cask` gives trust to the named packages, not the taps listed by `brew untrust --tap`. Consequently an untrusted tap with no installed item is omitted entirely—`aws/tap` in the added test fixture—and any listed tap remains untrusted to the pre-install check, so macOS CI will still emit the warning this change is intended to eliminate. Trust the dynamically collected `taps` directly rather than only matching installed packages.

Useful? React with 👍 / 👎.

items.author: moriya-fumio-thd
items.body: Disposition (orchestrator acceptance): fixed in f568eab6 for the aws/tap case. A listed tap with nothing installed now gets whole-tap trust, so no listed tap is omitted. The broader claim that every listed tap stays untrusted after item-level trust is contradicted by the measurement on 50c833b3 (job 110914945531): azure/bicep and hashicorp/tap cleared with item-level trust alone; only aws/tap, which has no installed item, kept warning. Final head f568eab6 (job 110919109271) shows Trusted formula x2 + Trusted tap: aws/tap and no warning.
